class Solution:
    def isPossibleToSplit(self, nums: List[int]) -> bool:
        # Count the frequency of each number
        counts = Counter(nums)
        
        # If any number appears more than 2 times, it's impossible to split
        # because each part can contain at most one instance of that number.
        # Since there are only 2 parts, max frequency allowed is 2.
        for count in counts.values():
            if count > 2:
                return False
                
        # If no number appears more than twice, we can always construct the split.
        # Elements appearing twice go one to nums1 and one to nums2.
        # Elements appearing once can be distributed evenly to fill the remaining spots.
        # Since total length is even, the number of elements appearing once is even,
        # so they can be split equally.
        return True
